lead: An isolate that parks on something the connection cannot fail wedges the whole core, as a silent hang.
body: A park on a `nvs_host::channel` receiver whose sender the same closure holds never returns: `Peer::drop` cancels then waits, and neither it nor `run_until_idle` unwedges the task. Park on the body instead: a head promising 100 bytes whose client sends four and closes parks the program inside `next_chunk`, where the connection can fail it.
